name: Birdhouse Brewing Company
description: Honeoye craft brewery with food, live music, and a creekside backyard reported by pet-travel listings as dog-friendly.

name: CB Craft Brewers
hoursNote: Public sources reported CB Craft Brewers permanently closed on September 1, 2019; no current official website was verified.
description: Former Honeoye Falls craft brewery from the dog-friendly source list; it appears permanently closed and should not be recommended as an active dog-friendly stop.

name: Deer Run Winery
hoursNote: Official site also lists Sunday brunch from 10:00 to 14:00; hours may change seasonally.
description: Conesus Lake winery and cafe; its FAQ says leashed dogs are allowed on the front porch.

name: Eagle Crest Vineyards
hoursNote: Official site asks visitors to check the event calendar for tasting-room hours and special events.
description: Historic Eagle Crest/O-Neh-Da vineyard near Hemlock Lake; pet-friendly visitor listings describe the property as welcoming to dogs.

name: FLPP Lakefront Homes
address: 103 Horizon Park Drive, Penn Yan, NY 14527
description: Finger Lakes Premier Properties offers pet-friendly vacation rentals and says dogs receive a welcome bag at eligible pet-friendly homes.

name: Hidden Marsh Distillery
description: Pet-friendly Martin Family craft distillery co-located with Montezuma Winery, offering small-batch spirits and tastings in Seneca Falls.

name: Inspire Moore Winery & Vineyard
hoursNote: Hours shown are official June-October hours; official site lists reduced seasonal hours for November-May.
description: Naples winery, vineyard, and venue; pet-travel listings report leashed dogs are welcome inside and outside.

name: Noble Shepherd Craft Brewery
hoursNote: Official site labels these as Noble Kitchen hours; confirm taproom and pet policy before visiting.
description: Bloomfield craft brewery with food service; pet-travel listings report dogs are welcome in the taproom and outdoor patio.

name: OSB Ciderworks
hoursNote: Current hours were found only in third-party pet-friendly listings, not on the official site; confirm before visiting.
description: Lakeville cidery also known as Original Stump Blower Ciderworks; pet-friendly listings report dogs are welcome indoors and outdoors.

name: Rising Storm Brewing Company
description: Rising Storm's Livonia/Avon taproom sits on a 12-acre property; visitor listings describe its outdoor areas as dog-friendly.

name: Sampson State Park
hoursNote: Official page says the park is open year-round dawn to dusk; daily hours are dawn to dark, and non-camping/non-slip visitors must leave by 22:00. Museum hours differ seasonally.
description: Dog-friendly state park on Seneca Lake; official pet policy allows up to two supervised pets in campsites and day-use areas unless prohibited by sign, with pets crated or leashed no longer than 6 feet.

name: Staving Artist Woodwork
hoursNote: Finger Lakes Tourism Alliance lists winter hours only; current non-winter hours were not verified.
description: Pet-friendly Penn Yan woodwork and gift shop specializing in handcrafted items made from reclaimed barrel staves and other sustainable materials.

name: Wagner Valley Brewing Co
hoursNote: Official hours page says winter hours vary and Friday summer music events may run after regular tasting hours.
description: Seneca Lake brewery at Wagner Vineyards; official dog policy welcomes friendly, well-behaved, leashed dogs on the lawn, seasonally enclosed deck, Vantage Point, and a designated cafe-deck section during regular business hours.
